_comment: ADR 0036 — canonical Claude Code Bash sandbox block. scripts/sync-sandbox.sh writes `sandbox` into .claude/settings.json when .juvant/config.json feature_toggles.bash_sandbox is true, filling network.allowedDomains from `binary_domains` (only the binaries some role is allowed in hooks/bash-policy.json) plus config sandbox.extra_domains. denyWrite mirrors the protected set in hooks/lib/guardrail-paths.sh (a test keeps them in step). Project working trees stay writable through permissions.additionalDirectories (scripts/sync-project-globs.sh). The two excludedCommands entries are the upstream-sync apply helper and helpers/fetch-origin.sh (refs/remotes/origin/ is write-denied, so a sandboxed git fetch of origin fails): Claude Code keeps a call sandboxed unless EVERY command in it matches, and a cd / redirect / $( ) keeps it sandboxed too.
